newsitem.title: GREECE: BASKETBALL-BOURGES WIN WOMEN'S EUROLEAGUE TROPHY.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-BOURGES WIN WOMEN'S EUROLEAGUE TROPHY.

text.p: France's Bourges scored a surprise 71-52 win over favourites Wuppertal of Germany in the women's EuroLeague final four tournament decider on Thursday.

Bourges took a 12-point lead early in the first half, capitalising on their height advantage inside the D with forwards Isabelle Fijalkowski , scorer of 24 points, and Kathy Melain, 18 points, dominating the boards.
With no hope close to the basket, Wuppertal relied on Australian guards Michelle Timms and Sandra Brondello for triples. But they both had a bad night, scoring only 22 points between them.

Wuppertal, who won the trophy last year in Sofia, had pivot Marlies Askamp as their top scorer with 14 points. They pulled down a total of 22 rebounds to to Bourges's 41 and shot only 35 percent to Bourges's 54 percent.

Bourges were indebted to playmaker Yannick Souvre who managed to keep a slow pace thoughout the match, fencing off counter-attacks by the faster Germans and brilliantly passing inside the D to Fijalkowski and Melain.
Italian side Como, twice European champions, were beaten 74-58 by Slovakia's Ruzomberok in the third place playoff.
